summary: Picks a value, or a range, on a continuous scale where the exact number matters less than the position.
whenToUse: Settings people tune by feel and check right away: volume, zoom, a price range filter.
Pair it with a NumberField when people also need to type an exact value.
whenNotToUse: Exact values such as a quantity or an amount of money: use NumberField.
A handful of named choices: use SegmentedControl or RadioGroup.

dos.title: Show the value and its unit
dos.text: format makes the value readable: 48%, 4.5, 16 px.

donts.title: A slider for precise input
donts.text: Dragging to exactly 37 is frustrating. Use NumberField when the exact number matters.

accessibility: Every thumb has an accessible name: the visible label, or aria-label for each end of a range.
Arrow keys move one step, Page Up and Page Down move ten, Home and End jump to the ends.
Show the current value as text next to the slider: color and position alone do not say it.
contentGuidelines: Label names the quantity: "Minimum contrast", not "Slide to adjust".
Use the hint for what the value affects.
